Direct Hits against <solar/>Scorched Enemies apply <pve 10 /> <pvp [4] /> additional <solar/>Scorch per Direct Hit (<pve 15 /> <pvp [9?] /> with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) on a 0.5 second cooldown.

Scoring 11 Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to <solar/>Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.

<solar/>Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.
